title: JmapRequestBuilder: call_ids HashSet is redundant with method_calls Vec
description: request.rs JmapRequestBuilder: The struct carries both method_calls: Vec<Invocation> and call_ids: HashSet<String>. The call_id is already stored as the third element of each Invocation tuple in method_calls. The HashSet exists solely for O(1) duplicate detection. With typical request sizes (2-10 calls) a linear scan of method_calls would have identical performance and eliminate the secondary data structure. Suggested rewrite: remove call_ids field, replace insert check with 'if self.method_calls.iter().any(|inv| inv.2 == call_id)'. This is not purely a style preference — the parallel structure means every add_call clones the call_id string twice (once into the HashSet, once into the Invocation). The Vec-scan approach clones it once.
